observation: Read the full candidate. A single-factor/single-algorithm limitation motivates three influence-characteristic families. The summary enumerates established and two new features, reduces each family through PCA, then combines three resulting vectors into node scores. Three test datasets and additional extraction/validation work are announced, but promisingperformance is unquantified here. The separate recommendation paragraph is overt author self-appraisal, with visualization quality only mentioned, not reviewed. A final Keywords list belongs to separate metadata rather than default imitation prose and needs source-bound ownership confirmation. The title and Abstract label are preserved. No mathematical or visual correctness and no whole-source completeness accepted.
